sections.h: 3. Intego n'ishingiro ry'amategeko byo gutunganya amakuru
sections.b:
Utanga Serivisi atunganya amakuru yihariye ku ntego zikurikira no ku ishingiro ry'amategeko rikurikira rikubiye mu ngingo ya 6(1) ya GDPR:

  • Kubahiriza inshingano z'amategeko (Ingingo ya 6(1)(c)): inshingano z'ibaruramari, imisoro n'ifagitire.
  • Inyungu zikwiye (Ingingo ya 6(1)(f)): kurinda Urubuga, gukumira uburiganya n'ihohoterwa, kubungabunga umutekano wa serivisi, kubika ibipimo by'imbere bya serivisi birinda ibanga, no gutunganya ibiriho rusange by'imbuga nkoranyambaga ku isesengura ry'ibigezweho.
  • Ubwumvikane (Ingingo ya 6(1)(a)): amakuru-remezo adakenewe n'ikoranabuhanga risa (reba Politiki y'amakuru-remezo) n'ibindi bice bizaza bishobora guhitamo bishingiye ku bwumvikane. Ubwumvikane bushobora gukurwaho igihe icyo aricyo cyose bigira ingaruka ku gihe kizaza.

sections.h: 4. Amafoto, Amajwi n'ibiriho byakozwe na AI
sections.b:

Ntabwo akoreshwa mu kumenya umuntu binyuze mu bimenyetso by'umubiri cyangwa mu gushyira mu byiciro umuntu uwo ari we wese binyuze mu bimenyetso by'umubiri, kandi ntabwo akoreshwa na Utanga Serivisi mu gutoreza imashini z'ubwenge bw'ubukorano.

4.2. Iyo gukora avatar cyangwa ijwi rimeze kimwe bisaba kwandikisha ibikoresho n'umutanga serivisi wa AI w'undi muntu (urugero HeyGen cyangwa ElevenLabs), ibikoresho byoherezwa kuri uwo mutanga serivisi gusa ku gikorwa cyasabwe kandi bigatunganywa hakurikijwe amabwiriza y'uwo mutanga serivisi n'amasezerano yo gutunganya amakuru.

4.3. Ushobora gusiba ibikoresho bya media byawe bya uploadinze n'ibyakozwe muri gallery y'Urubuga igihe icyo aricyo cyose. Iyo konti yawe isibwe, ibiriho bifitanye isano birakurwaho, keretse iyo kubika bisabwa n'amategeko (reba Igice cya 7).

4.4. Ugomba kuba ufite uburenganzira bukenewe n'ubwumvikane bw'umuntu uwo ari we wese ifoto cyangwa ijwi rye uloadinze cyangwa ukora kimwe. Inshingano zirambuye zigaragara mu Mabwiriza y'Imikoreshereze.

sections.h: 5. Itangazwa ry'Amakuru ku Bandi Bantu (Abatunganya Amakuru)
sections.b:
Mu rwego rwo gukoresha Urubuga, Umutanga Serivisi akoresha serivisi zizewe z'abandi bantu bashobora kubona amakuru make mu buryo bw'amasezerano akomeye, kandi gusa mu rugero rubikenewe:

  • Kwishyura: Stripe (kwishyura imyaka, gutanga fagitire, gukumira uburiganya).
  • Ubumenyi bw'ubukorikori (Artificial intelligence): Google (models za Gemini), Anthropic (models za Claude), OpenAI, FAL.ai, HeyGen (gushushanya avatar), ElevenLabs (guhimba ijwi no gukora kopi y'ijwi) — binyuze muri API zabo zemewe. Gusa ibikubiye bikenewe ku gikorwa runaka ukoresheje nibyo bitangwa.
  • Amakuru y'imbuga nkoranyambaga: TikHub (kubona ibikubiye kuri porogaramu n'ibipimo bya rubanda).
  • Gutangaza: Blotato n'imbuga nkoranyambaga uhuza (TikTok, Meta/Instagram, YouTube/Google) — zibona ibikubiye uteganya gutangaza n'amakuru y'ibanga wahuje muri konti zawe.
  • Kwiyandikisha: Google (uburyo bwa "Sign in with Google" butabaho itegeko).

Iyo uhuje urufunguzo rwawe rwa API cyangwa ubwishyu bwa serivisi y'undi muntu, iyo serivisi itunganya amakuru yawe hashingiwe ku masezerano yawe na yo; Umutanga Serivisi atanga gusa ibyifuzo byawe mu izina ryawe.

Umutanga Serivisi ntabwo agurisha amakuru bwite kandi ntabwo ayikoresha mu kwamamaza cyangwa kugurisha ibicuruzwa by'abandi bantu.

6.2. Bamwe mu batanga serivisi bavuzwe mu Gice cya 5 (urugero Stripe, Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, FAL.ai, Blotato) baherereye muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika cyangwa mu bindi bihugu bya gatatu. Kohereza amakuru kuri abo batanga serivisi bikorwa hashingiwe ku cyemezo cy'uburyo buhagije cya Komisiyo y'u Burayi (harimo n'Ihuriro ry'Ubwitegererezo bw'Amakuru hagati y'Uburayi na Amerika, iyo umutanga serivisi yemejwe) cyangwa hashingiwe ku Ngingo z'Amasezerano zisanzwe za Komisiyo y'u Burayi (Ingingo ya 46(2)(c) ya GDPR) hamwe n'ingamba z'inyongera aho bikenewe.

6.3. Kopi y'ingamba z'umutekano zirebana n'ibyo ishobora gusabwa binyuze kuri imeyili y'itumanaho yagaragajwe mu Gice cya 1.

  • Urufunguzo rw'ihuriro (BYOK): kugeza igihe urukuyemo mu igenamiterere cyangwa ufunze konti yawe; rubikwa mu buryo bwa kode mu gihe cyose.
  • Amakuru y'ikoranabuhanga: nk'itegeko, ntabwo arenza amezi 12, keretse iyo hakenewe igihe kirekire kugira ngo hakorwe iperereza ku bibazo by'umutekano cyangwa bitewe n'amategeko.
  • Inyandiko z'ubwishyu: mu gihe gisabwa n'amategeko y'imisoro akurikizwa.

8.1. Umutanga Serivisi akoresha ingamba zigezweho z'ikoranabuhanga n'iz'imiterere: kohereza amakuru mu buryo bwa kode (HTTPS/TLS), gukoresha hashing ku magana y'ibanga, gukoresha kode ku rufunguzo rwa API rubitswe, kurinda imikoreshereze ya JWT, kugenzura uburyo bwo kwinjira n'ihame ryo kugabanya uburenganzira.

8.2. Kwinjira ku makuru bwite bigarukira ku bantu babikeneye kugira ngo bakoreshe Urubuga kandi bagomba kubahiriza ibanga.

8.3. Mu gihe habayeho kurenga ku makuru bwite bishobora guteza akaga ku burenganzira n'ubwisanzure bwawe, Umutanga Serivisi azamenyesha ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha kandi, aho bisabwa n'Ingingo ya 34 ya GDPR, abakoresha bagizweho ingaruka.

Ufite uburenganzira bwo:

  • gusaba kureba amakuru yawe bwite no kubona kopi yayo;
  • gusaba gukosora amakuru atari yo cyangwa atuzuye;

  • gusaba kugabanya uburyo bwo gutunganya amakuru;
  • kubona amakuru yawe mu buryo bwateguwe, bushobora gusomwa n'imashini no kuyohereza ku wundi mutunganya amakuru (kohereza amakuru);
  • kwanga gutunganya amakuru bishingiye ku nyungu zikwiye, bitewe n'imiterere yawe bwite;

Kugira ngo ukoreshe ubwo burenganzira, ohereza ubusabe kuri SEO@trendtraffic.pro. Umutanga Serivisi asubiza mu gihe cy'ukwezi kumwe (bishobora kongerwa amezi abiri y'inyongera ku busabe bugoye, hamwe n'imenyesha).

sections.h: 10. Ubwenge bw'ubukorano n'Amabwiriza (EU) 2024/1689 (Itegeko rya EU ryerekeye AI)
sections.b:
10.1. Urubuga rwishyiramo imiterere y'ubwenge bw'ubukorano rusange iboneka ku mugaragaro itangwa n'abandi binyuze muri API zabo zemewe (Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, FAL.ai) mu gusesengura ibigezweho, gutanga inyandiko n'amagambo y'ingenzi, gusemura, gusesengura amashusho buri gace, gukora amashusho y'abantu n'ijwi ry'ubukorano. Utanga serivisi ntabwo akora cyangwa ngo atoze imiterere ye bwite y'ubwenge bw'ubukorano kandi ntabwo ari utanga imiterere y'ubwenge bw'ubukorano rusange mu buryo bw'Amabwiriza (EU) 2024/1689 ("Itegeko rya EU ryerekeye AI").

10.2. Imikoreshereze y'ubwenge bw'ubukorano bw'Urubuga iri mu byiciro by'ibibazo bike n'ibibazo bito by'Itegeko rya EU ryerekeye AI. Urubuga ntabwo rukoresha sisitemu z'ubwenge bw'ubukorano zifite ibibazo byinshi mu buryo bw'Igice cya III cy'Amabwiriza.

10.3. Kugaragaza ibikoresho by'ubukorano: Urubuga ni igikoresho cyo gukora amashusho, amajwi n'amashusho (harimo n'amashusho y'abantu n'amajwi yigana) byakozwe n'ubwenge bw'ubukorano cyangwa byahinduwe n'ubwenge bw'ubukorano. Ibikoresho by'ubwenge bw'ubukorano bigaragara neza ku rubuga. Aho abatanga ubwenge bw'ubukorano bashyira ibimenyetso bisomwa n'imashini cyangwa ibimenyetso by'amazi mu bikoresho byakozwe (Ingingo ya 50(2) y'Itegeko rya EU ryerekeye AI), Urubuga rubibika kandi ntabwo rubikuraho. Abakoresha bategetswe mu masezerano kugaragaza amashusho y'ibihimbano n'ibindi bikoresho by'ubukorano nk'uko bisabwa n'Ingingo ya 50(4) y'Itegeko rya EU ryerekeye AI ndetse n'amabwiriza y'imbuga nkoranyambaga babishyiraho (reba Amategeko n'Amabwiriza).

10.4. Imyitozo ibuzanyijwe n'Ingingo ya 5 y'Itegeko rya EU ryerekeye AI — uburiganya bw'ibitekerezo, gukoresha intege nke (harimo n'iz'abana), gushyira abantu mu byiciro, gusesengura mbere ibyaha by'abantu, gushakisha amashusho y'amaso ku mbuga za interineti cyangwa CCTV, kumenya amarangamutima mu kazi no mu mashuri, gushyira mu byiciro abantu hakoreshejwe ibimenyetso by'umubiri bishingiye ku bintu byihariye, no kumenya abantu hakoreshejwe ibimenyetso by'umubiri mu gihe nyacyo mu hantu rusange — ntabwo bitangwa n'Urubuga, birabujijwe n'Amategeko n'Amabwiriza, kandi ibyifuzo bigamije iyo myitozo birangwa.

10.5. Kugenzura n'umuntu: Ibyavuye mu bwenge bw'ubukorano (isesengura, inyandiko, amagambo y'ingenzi, amashusho yakozwe) ni inyandiko z'ibanze zishobora kuba zirimo amakosa. Abakoresha basuzuma kandi bemeza ibikoresho mbere yo kubikoresha cyangwa kubishyira ahagaragara.

Urubuga ni igikoresho cy'umwuga kigenewe abantu bafite imyaka nibura 18. Utanga serivisi ntabwo akusanya abizi amakuru yihariye y'abana. Niba ukeka ko umwana yatanze amakuru yihariye ku Rubuga, nyamuneka hamagara SEO@trendtraffic.pro kandi ayo makuru azahanagurwa.

Utanga serivisi ashobora kuvugurura aya Mabwiriza, cyane cyane kugira ngo agaragaze impinduka mu mategeko cyangwa mu mikorere y'Urubuga. 5.2. Ubwishyu bukorwa n'umutanga serivisi w'ubwishyu Stripe. Umutanga serivisi ntabika amakuru yuzuye y'ikarita yo kwishyura.

5.3. Iyandikisha ryivugurura mu buryo bwikora mu bihe by'ukwezi bikurikirana kugeza rihagaritswe. Ushobora guhagarika igihe icyo aricyo cyose mu igenamiterere ry'ubwishyu; guhagarika bitangira gukurikizwa mu mpera z'igihe cyishyuwe kiriho, kandi ukomeza kubona serivisi kugeza icyo gihe.

5.4. Umutanga serivisi ashobora guhindura ibiciro by'iyandikisha. Impinduka z'ibiciro zitangazwa nibura iminsi 14 mbere kandi zikurikizwa gusa uhereye ku gihe cy'ubwishyu gikurikiyeho; niba utabyemera, ushobora guhagarika mbere y'uko igiciro gishya gitangira gukurikizwa.

5.5. Ibiciro by'abandi ntibishyizwemo mu iyandikisha: ibiciro by'imfunguzo za API z'Umukoresha n'iyandikisha (urugero: Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, FAL.ai, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Blotato, TikHub), komisiyo z'abatanga serivisi z'ubwishyu n'ibiciro by'imbuga nkoranyambaga bishyurwa n'Umukoresha mu buryo bweruye ku batanga serivisi bakwiye mu buryo bwabo.

sections.h: 6. Politiki yo Kutagarura Amafaranga n'Uburenganzira bwo Kwivana muri Serivisi
sections.b:
6.1. Urubuga rutanga uburyo bwuzuye bwo kubona ibirimo bya digitale n'ibikoresho byo kubara (harimo n'ikiguzi cyo gutunganya ibyifuzo bya AI) ako kanya nyuma yo kwishyura neza.

6.2. Abaguzi muri EU — kureka uburenganzira bwo kwivana muri serivisi: mu buryo buhuje n'Icyerekezo 2011/83/EU n'Itegeko rya Polonye ryo ku ya 30 Gicurasi 2014 ryerekeye Uburenganzira bw'Abaguzi (cyane cyane ingingo zerekeye itangwa ry'ibirimo bya digitale na serivisi za digitale), mu gukora iyandikisha ryishyuwe umuguzi asaba mu buryo bweruye kandi yemera ko imikorere itangira ako kanya, mbere y'uko igihe gisanzwe cy'iminsi 14 cyo kwivana muri serivisi kirangira, kandi yemera ko ahita abura uburenganzira bwo kwivana muri serivisi uhereye igihe serivisi yashyizweho mu buryo bwuzuye. Uku kwemera no kumenya byongeye gukusanywa mu gihe cyo kwishyura.

6.3. Bityo, ubwishyu ni ubwa nyuma kandi ntibugarurwa, harimo n'igihe Umukoresha ahagaritse iyandikisha mbere y'impera z'igihe cy'ubwishyu cyishyuwe (uburyo bwo kubona serivisi bukomereza kugeza impera z'icyo gihe). Igerageza ry'ubuntu ry'iminsi 7 (Ingingo ya 4) ritangwa neza kugira ngo serivisi ishobore gusuzumwa mu buryo bwuzuye mbere y'uko ubwishyu ubwo aribwo bwose bukorwa.

6.4. Ingingo za 6.1–6.3 ntizikuraho cyangwa ngo zigabanye uburenganzira ubwo aribwo bwose amategeko ateganya atanga ku baguzi kandi atashobora kurekurwa, harimo n'uburyo bwemewe n'amategeko bwo gukemura ibibazo by'uko ibirimo bya digitale na serivisi za digitale bidahuye (Icyerekezo (EU) 2019/770 n'ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryacyo muri Polonye). Aho izo ngingo ziteganya zikurikizwa, zihabwa agaciro kuruta iyi Ngingo.

6.5. Ku Bakoresha batari abaguzi (abakoresha b'ubucuruzi), ibiciro byose ni ibya nyuma kandi ntibigarurwa mu buryo bwuzuye bwemewe n'amategeko.

sections.h: 7. BYOK Integrations, Chrome Extension na MCP
sections.b:
7.1. Urubuga rwemera Umukoresha guhuza imfunguzo ze bwite za API n'uburyo bwo kwiyandikisha kuri serivisi z'abandi bantu ("BYOK") — urugero Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, FAL.ai, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Blotato cyangwa TikHub. Izo serivisi zikoreshwa mu masezerano y'Umukoresha bwite n'abatanga izo serivisi; Umukoresha ni we wishyura ibijyanye n'izo serivisi kandi ni we ushinzwe kubahiriza amategeko y'abo batanga serivisi.

7.2. TrendTraffic Chrome extension ihuza ibintu bimwe na bimwe (urugero HeyGen, Google Flow, NotebookLM) binyuze mu konti z'Umukoresha bwite n'uburyo bwo kwiyandikisha mu mushakisha w'Umukoresha. Umukoresha ni we ushinzwe gukoresha izo konti mu buryo buhuje n'amategeko ya serivisi zikoreshwa; Umutanga serivisi ntabwo yemeza ko extension izahora ihuza neza n'imigaragarire y'abandi bantu kandi ashobora kuvugurura cyangwa guhagarika ibihuza bimwe na bimwe niba undi muntu ahinduye amategeko cyangwa ikoranabuhanga rye.

7.3. Imfunguzo za API zatanzwe n'Umukoresha zibitswe mu buryo bw'ibanga kandi zikoreshwa gusa mu gukora ibikorwa byasabwe n'Umukoresha. Umukoresha ashobora kuzisiba igihe icyo aricyo cyose mu igenamiterere.

7.4. Urufunguzo rwa MCP rwihariye rwemera abafasha ba AI (urugero Claude) kwinjira kuri konti y'Umukoresha. Umukoresha ni we ushinzwe kugira urufunguzo rw'ibanga no kubahiriza ibikorwa byose bikoreshejwe, kandi ashobora kurukuraho igihe icyo aricyo cyose.

8.1. Umukoresha yiyemeje kutazakoresha Urubuga mu bikorwa bikurikira:

  • igikorwa icyo aricyo cyose kitemewe n'amategeko, spam, phishing cyangwa uburyo ubwo aribwo bwose bw'uburiganya;
  • gukora, gusesengura cyangwa gukwirakwiza ibintu bitemewe n'amategeko, biteye isoni, bihohotera, cyangwa bihungabanya uburenganzira bw'umutungo mu by'ubwenge, ubuzima bwite cyangwa uburenganzira bwo kumenyekana kw'abandi bantu;
  • gukora cyangwa gukoresha ishusho cyangwa ijwi ry'umuntu nyamuntu nta burenganzira bukenewe cyangwa ubwumvikane bw'uwo muntu, harimo kwiyitirira abantu nyamuntu;
  • gukora ibintu bifite ishingiro ry'imibonano mpuzabitsina, by'ibanga cyangwa bihohotera bigaragaza abantu nyamuntu bashobora kumenyekana nta bwumvikane bwabo bweruye, cyangwa ibintu nk'ibyo byose birebana n'abana bato (ibyo birabujijwe rwose kandi bizamenyeshwa inzego zibifitiye ububasha);
  • gukora ibintu bishukana bigamije kuyobya rubanda, harimo amakuru y'ibinyoma yerekeye amatora, ubuzima rusange cyangwa umutekano;
  • guhungabanya amategeko agenga serivisi z'abandi bantu zihujwe (cyane cyane TikTok, Meta/Instagram, YouTube/Google, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Blotato, Stripe), harimo amategeko yabo yerekeye ibinyabuzima byakozwe na mashini n'ibitangazwa mu buryo bwikora;
  • kugerageza guhungabanya, kuremerera, gusubiza inyuma cyangwa kwinjira mu buryo butemewe ku Rubuga;
  • gukoresha ibintu bya AI mu buryo bunyuranyije n'ingingo ya 5 y'Itegeko (EU) 2024/1689 (EU AI Act), harimo no mu bikorwa bikurikira: uburiganya bw'ibanga; gukoresha intege nke z'abana cyangwa amatsinda yoroshye; gushyira abantu mu byiciro; gusuzuma mbere ibyaha by'abantu; gukusanya amashusho y'amaso mu buryo butagenwe kuva kuri interineti cyangwa CCTV; kumenya amarangamutima y'abakozi cyangwa abanyeshuri; gushyira mu byiciro abantu hakoreshejwe ibimenyetso by'umubiri bishingiye ku bintu by'ibanga; cyangwa kumenya abantu hakoreshejwe ibimenyetso by'umubiri mu buryo bw'igihe nyacyo mu bice rusange.

8.2. Mu gushyiraho ifoto cyangwa ijwi ryanditswe, Umukoresha yemeza kandi atanga garanti ko ari we muntu ugaragara/wanditswe cyangwa afite ubwumvikane bweruye, bwamenyekanye bw'uwo muntu (kandi, ku bikoresho bifite uburenganzira bw'umwanditsi, afite impushya zikenewe).

8.3. Mu gihe habayeho kurenga ku mategeko, Umutanga serivisi ashobora gukuraho ibintu byarenzweho kandi agahagarika cyangwa agafunga konti y'Umukoresha nta kugarura amafaranga (Ingingo ya 13), nta kubangamira izindi ngamba z'amategeko.

sections.h: 9. Ibintu bya AI, Ibintu byakozwe na mashini n'Ubusobanuro
sections.b:
9.1. Ibintu bya AI by'Urubuga bikora ku mibare rusange y'abandi batanga serivisi (Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, FAL.ai) bikoreshwa binyuze muri API zemewe. Ibisobanuro by'uburyo bwo gutunganya amakuru bigaragara muri Politiki y'ibanga.

9.2. Ibintu byakozwe na AI (isesengura, inyandiko, amagambo y'ingenzi, amajwi, amashusho) bishobora kuba birimo amakosa cyangwa ibitagenda neza kandi ntabwo bigize inama z'umwuga, z'amategeko, z'ubuvuzi cyangwa z'imari. Umukoresha agomba gusuzuma ibintu byakozwe mbere yo kubikoresha cyangwa kubitangaza kandi ni we ubihamya byuzuye ku mikoreshereze yabyo.

9.3. Kumenyekanisha ibintu byakozwe na mashini: igihe Umukoresha akora cyangwa agahindura amashusho, amajwi cyangwa amashusho agaragara nk'abantu, ibintu, ahantu cyangwa ibyabayeho kandi bishobora kugaragara nka by'ukuri cyangwa byizewe (a "deep fake"), Umukoresha agomba kugaragaza neza kandi mu buryo butandukanye ko ibyo bintu byakozwe cyangwa byahinduwe mu buryo bw'ubukorikori, mu buryo buhuje n'ingingo ya 50(4) y'Itegeko rya EU AI Act n'amategeko y'imbuga nkoranyambaga aho ibyo bintu bitangazwa. Igihe abatanga serivisi za AI b'abandi bantu bashyiramo ibimenyetso bishobora gusomwa na mashini cyangwa ibimenyetso by'amazi mu bikorwa byakozwe, Umukoresha ntagomba kubikuraho cyangwa kubihisha.

9.4. Umutanga serivisi ntabwo yemeza ko ibintu byakozwe na AI bidafite uburenganzira bw'abandi bantu (urugero igihe ibyo Umukoresha yashyizemo birimo ibintu birinzwe) kandi ntabwo yemeza ko hazabaho umusaruro w'ubucuruzi runaka (kurebwa, kugera kure, kwinjiza amafaranga).

10.1. Umukoresha agumana uburenganzira bwose ku bikoresho yashyizeho. Umukoresha aha Umutanga serivisi uruhushya rudaharanira inyungu, rwemewe ku rwego rw'isi yose rwo kwakira, kubika, gutunganya, guhindura no kohereza ibyo bikoresho gusa mu rugero rukenewe kugira ngo hatangwe serivisi za Platform (harimo no kubyohereza ku batanga serivisi za AI n'imbuga nkoranyambaga zatoranyijwe n'Umukoresha). Uru ruhushya rurangira iyo ibirimo cyangwa konti byasibwe, usibye kopi zisabwa n'amategeko.

10.2. Hagati y'Umutanga serivisi n'Umukoresha, Umutanga serivisi ntabwo asaba uburenganzira ku musaruro ugenewe Umukoresha. Uburenganzira bw'Umukoresha ku musaruro ukomoka kuri AI bugenwa n'amategeko agenga n'amabwiriza y'abatanga serivisi za AI b'abandi bantu; Umukoresha ni we ushinzwe kugenzura ko imikoreshereze ateganya yemewe.

10.3. Porogaramu ya Platform, igishushanyo, ibirango n'ububiko bw'amakuru bigumana kuba umutungo w'Umutanga serivisi cyangwa abamuhaye uruhushya. Aya Mabwiriza ntabwo atanga uburenganzira ubwo aribwo bwose kuri ibyo birenze uburenganzira bwo gukoresha Platform nk'uko byateganyijwe.

10.4. Ibirimo by'abandi bantu bigaragara mu isesengura ry'ibigezweho (amashusho, amakoveri, imibare ya TikTok/Instagram/YouTube) bigumana kuba umutungo w'abafite uburenganzira n'imbuga zabo; bigaragara mu isesengura ry'isoko. Ikindi gikoresho cyose cy'ibyo birimo n'Umukoresha (urugero, kongera gushyiraho videwo y'undi muntu) bisaba Umukoresha kugira ishingiro rye bwite ry'amategeko.

sections.h: 11. Kurinda Amakuru; Gutunganya Amakuru mu izina ry'Umukoresha
sections.b:
11.1. Gutunganya amakuru bwite y'Abakoresha bisobanurwa muri Politiki y'Ubuzima bwite.

11.2. Iyo ibikoresho Umukoresha ashyiraho cyangwa atunganya kuri Platform birimo amakuru bwite y'abandi bantu (urugero, ishusho cyangwa ijwi ry'umunyamakuru, ibitekerezo by'abakiriya), Umukoresha aba ari Ugenzura Amakuru y'ayo makuru naho Umutanga serivisi akayatunganya nk'Umutunganya mu buryo bw'ingingo ya 28 ya GDPR — gusa ku mabwiriza yanditse y'Umukoresha agaragazwa binyuze mu gukoresha ibiranga Platform, kandi gusa kugira ngo atange serivisi.

11.3. Umutanga serivisi akoresha ingamba zikwiye z'umutekano za tekiniki n'iz'imirimo, akoresha gusa abatunganya amakuru bato bavugwa muri Politiki y'Ubuzima bwite (Umukoresha yemera gukoreshwa kwabo; impinduka zikomeye zizatangazwa), afasha Umukoresha mu buryo bukwiriye ku bijyanye n'ibisabwa n'abafite amakuru, kandi agasiba cyangwa agasubiza amakuru iyo serivisi irangiye hakurikijwe amategeko yo kubika amakuru muri Politiki y'Ubuzima bwite.

12.1. "Nk'uko biri": Platform itangwa "nk'uko iri" na "nk'uko iboneka". Mu rugero rwemerwa n'amategeko, Umutanga serivisi ntabwo atanga garanti ko Platform izakora nta guhagarara cyangwa amakosa cyangwa ko izahura n'ibyifuzo byihariye by'Umukoresha.

12.2. Kugendera ku bandi bantu: Imikorere ya Platform igendera cyane ku batanga serivisi b'abandi bantu. Umutanga serivisi ntabwo abazwa: guhagarara, impinduka z'amategeko cyangwa imipaka ya API na serivisi za TikTok, Meta/Instagram, YouTube/Google, TikHub, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Google (Gemini, Flow, NotebookLM), Anthropic, OpenAI, FAL.ai, Blotato cyangwa Stripe; ku byemezo byo kugenzura by'imbuga nkoranyambaga ku bijyanye n'ibirimo by'Umukoresha byashyizweho; cyangwa ku bibazo biterwa n'abatanga serivisi zo kwakira.

12.3. Mu rugero rwemerwa n'amategeko, Umutanga serivisi ntabwo abazwa ibyangiritse bitaziguye, inyungu zabuze, gutakaza amakuru cyangwa gutakaza abakiriya biturutse ku gukoresha, cyangwa kutabasha gukoresha, Platform.

12.4. Inshingano ntarengwa y'Umutanga serivisi ku Mukoresha ku bijyanye n'ibirego byose ifite agaciro kangana n'amafaranga Umukoresha yishyuye mu by'ukuri kuri serivisi za Platform mu kwezi kwa kalendari kwa nyuma kubanjirije ikibazo cyateje ikirego.

12.5. Imipaka iri muri iki Gice ntabwo ikoreshwa ku nshingano z'amakosa yabigambiriwe cyangwa uburangare bukabije, ku rupfu cyangwa gukomereka umuntu, cyangwa mu bindi bihe aho inshingano zidashobora kugabanywa n'amategeko agenga. Ku baguzi, uburenganzira bw'amategeko ku bijyanye no kutubahiriza amasezerano ya serivisi za digitale bugumana (Igice cya 6.4).

13.1. Umukoresha ashobora guhagarika gukoresha Platform no gusiba konti igihe icyo aricyo cyose; Igice cya 6 gikoreshwa ku byishyurwa byamaze gukorwa.

13.2. Umutanga serivisi ashobora guhagarika cyangwa gusoza konti, gusiba ibirimo no kwanga gutanga serivisi — nta gusubiza amafaranga yamaze kwishyurwa — mu gihe habayeho kurenga ku Mabwiriza aya (cyane cyane Igice cya 8), iyo bisabwa n'amategeko cyangwa n'itegeko ry'ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha, cyangwa mu gihe habayeho ikibazo gikomeye cy'umutekano. Iyo bikwiye, Umutanga serivisi azabanza gutanga umuburo no gushyiraho igihe ntarengwa cyo gukosora ikosa; ku baguzi, uburenganzira bw'amategeko ku bijyanye n'ibihe byishyuwe bugumana iyo gusoza atari ukubera ikosa ry'umuguzi.

13.3. Ibigice 6, 10, 12 na 15 bigumana nyuma yo gusoza.

14.1. Umutanga serivisi ashobora kuvugurura aya Mabwiriza kubera impamvu zumvikana: impinduka mu mategeko, ibiranga bishya, ibisabwa n'umutekano cyangwa impinduka kuri serivisi z'abandi bantu zishyirwaho.

14.2. Abakoresha bazamenyeshwa impinduka zikomeye nibura iminsi 14 mbere y'uko zitangira gukora, binyuze kuri imeri cyangwa muri porogaramu. Niba Umukoresha atabyemera, ashobora gusoza ubunyamuryango mbere y'uko impinduka zitangira gukora; gukomeza gukoresha nyuma y'iyo tariki bigaragaza ko abyemeye.

15.1. Aya Mategeko agengwa n'amategeko ya Repubulika ya Polonye. Niba Umukoresha ari umuguzi, guhitamo aya mategeko ntibimwambura uburenganzira bwo kurindwa n'amategeko agenga aho atuye buri gihe (Ingingo ya 6(2) y'Amabwiriza (EC) No 593/2008, "Roma I").

15.2. Ku bakoresha b'ubucuruzi, impaka zikemurirwa mu rukiko rufite ububasha bwihariye ruri ku cyicaro cyanditswe cya Serivisi (Warsaw, Polonye). Ku baguzi, ububasha bw'urukiko bugenwa n'amategeko agenga.

15.3. Umuguzi ashobora gukoresha uburyo bwo kuregera no gukemura impaka butanyuze mu nkiko, urugero nko gufashwa n'Ikigo cy'Ubucuruzi cya Polonye (Inspekcja Handlowa), abashinzwe kurengera abaguzi mu mijyi cyangwa mu turere, cyangwa ibigo bya ADR by'igihugu cyabo. (Ihuriro rya EU ryo gukemura impaka kuri interineti ryahagaritswe muri Nyakanga 2025.)

15.4. Ibinyuranye bishobora koherezwa kuri SEO@trendtraffic.pro; Serivisi isubiza mu minsi 14.

cookies.title: Politiki y'Amakuru Ngendanwa (Cookies)
cookies.subtitle: ya TrendTraffic
cookies.metaDescription: Ni ayahe makuru ngendanwa (cookies) na Local Storage TrendTraffic ikoresha, ku bw'iki, igihe kingana iki, ni bahe bantu ba gatatu bashyiraho amakuru ngendanwa (Stripe, Google sign-in), n'uko watanga, wanze cyangwa uhindura uburenganzira bwawe.

sections.h: 1. Amakuru Ngendanwa (Cookies) n'Ikoranabuhanga Bisa nabyo ni Iki
sections.b:
1.1. Amakuru ngendanwa (Cookies) ni udukoresho duto tw'inyandiko tubikwa ku gikoresho cyawe iyo usuye urubuga, bituma urubuga rushobora kumenya igikoresho cyawe no kwibuka ibyo ukunda.

1.2. Usibye amakuru ngendanwa (cookies), urubuga rwa TrendTraffic rukoresha Local Storage ya mushakisha — mu bindi, kubika ikimenyetso cy'uburenganzira cya session yawe, ururimi rwawe n'insanganyamatsiko y'imigaragarire, n'ihitamo ryawe ryo kwemerera amakuru ngendanwa. Iyi Politiki ikoreshwa ku makuru ngendanwa (cookies) na Local Storage kimwe.

2.1. Ngombwa cyane (tekiniki) — akenewe kugira ngo Urubuga rukore; akoreshwa hashingiwe ku nyungu zemewe za Serivisi kandi ntasaba uburenganzira:

  • vibevox_token — ikimenyetso cy'uburenganzira cya JWT cya session yawe (Local Storage; kugeza ugeze hanze cyangwa ikimenyetso kirangiye);
  • vibevox_user — ububiko bwa cache y'umukoresha winjiye (Local Storage; kugeza ugeze hanze);
  • tt_cookie_consent — ibika ihitamo ryawe ryo kwemerera amakuru ngendanwa (Local Storage; kugeza uhinduye cyangwa ubisibye).

2.2. Akora (ibyo ukunda):

  • i18nextLng — ururimi rw'imigaragarire rwahiswemo (Local Storage; kugeza ruhinduwe cyangwa rusibwe);
  • vibevox_theme — insanganyamatsiko y'umucyo/umwijima (Local Storage; kugeza ihinduwe cyangwa isibwe).

Kubera impamvu z'amateka, ibimenyetso bimwe na bimwe bifite inyuguti ya mbere "vibevox" y'umurongo w'ibicuruzwa bya Serivisi bya mbere; ni ibya TrendTraffic.

2.3. Ubusesenguzi: Urubuga ubu ntirushyiraho abashinzwe ubusesenguzi cyangwa abashinzwe kwamamaza ba gatatu. Imibare y'ibanze ya serivisi irinda ubuzima bwite ikusanywa ku ruhande rwa seriveri nta gukurikirana hagati y'imbuga. Niba ubusesenguzi bushingiye ku burenganzira bwigeze butangizwa, buzahita butangira gusa nyuma yo guhitamo "Emera byose".

2.4. Amakuru ngendanwa (cookies) ya gatatu: serivisi zo hanze zishyirwa mu Rubuga zishobora gushyiraho amakuru ngendanwa yazo iyo uzikoresheje:

  • Stripe — umutekano w'ubwishyu no gukumira uburiganya ku mpapuro z'ubwishyu n'iz'ibicuruzwa (urugero __stripe_mid, ~umwaka 1; __stripe_sid, ~iminota 30);
  • Google — iyo ukoresheje "Injira na Google", Google ishyiraho amakuru ngendanwa hashingiwe kuri politiki yayo;
  • Imbuga nkoranyambaga zihujwe (TikTok, Meta/Instagram, YouTube) — gusa mu migaragarire yazo iyo uzihuje cyangwa uzifunguye.

• Kumenyekanisha no kurinda session y'Umukoresha.
  • Umutekano w'ibikorwa by'ubwishyu.
  • Kwibuka ururimi, insanganyamatsiko n'ihitamo ryawe ryo kwemerera.
  • Kugira ngo serivisi ikore neza kandi idahagarara.

4.1. Ku isura yawe ya mbere, Urubuga rugaragaza umwanya w'uburenganzira uhuje n'Ingingo ya 399 y'Itegeko rya Polonye ry'Itumanaho rya Elegitoroniki (Prawo komunikacji elektronicznej), GDPR n'Icyerekezo cya ePrivacy (2002/58/EC). Ushobora guhitamo "Emera byose" cyangwa "Ngombwa gusa" — ubu buryo bwombi buragerwaho kimwe, kandi nta koranabuhanga ridakenewe rikorwa mbere y'ihitamo ryawe.

4.2. Ushobora guhindura ihitamo ryawe igihe icyo aricyo cyose — koresha umurongo wa "Amakuru ngendanwa (Cookie settings)" mu gice cyo hasi cy'urubuga cyangwa akabuto kari munsi y'iyi Politiki; umwanya uzongera gufunguka.

4.3. Imishakisha myinshi kandi igufasha guhagarika cyangwa gusiba amakuru ngendanwa (cookies) na Local Storage mu igenamiterere ryayo (Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Safari, Microsoft Edge). Icyitonderwa: niba ibintu bikenewe cyane byahagaritswe cyangwa bisibwe burundu, kwinjira no gukoresha Urubuga bizaba bidashoboka.
